metadata.hypothesis: A pilot-fixed linear bottleneck has a reproducible positive dependency-recovery effect over validation-tuned Lasso in a mild-nonlinearity regime.

pre_specified_gate.positive_cell: delta >= 0.03, bootstrap lower CI > 0, Holm p < 0.05, BN AUPRC > Lasso and edge prevalence, and BN MSE <= 1.10 * Lasso
pre_specified_gate.mild_regime: At least two of 0.2/0.3/0.4 pass across every requested K at at least one T.

regime_outcome.rule: At least two of strengths 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4 must pass for every requested K at the same T.
